$comment: Projectiles (ruleset v0; spec S2 section 6.1, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). Range on flat ground in calm air; flight time scales with distance; windPermillePerMPerS of range per m/s of wind along the shot, clamped; heightGainPerMm of range per mm the shooter stands above the target, capped; hit chance near (up to the close share of range) falling linearly to far; damage before the target's arrowTakenPermille; reload and ammunition per regiment volley. The siege stone joined with the engines (M5 item 6); the crossbow bolt waits for its user (Pavise Crossbowmen).

projectiles.$comment: Spec S2 6.4: a stone thrower's stone. Fires at a target regiment whose outline is between minRangeMm and the range (after wind and height); ammo is per engine; each crewed engine of the regiment throws one stone a reload. A stone lands at the aim point plus a seeded scatter growing from scatterNearMm at minRangeMm to scatterFarMm at full range; soldiers within crushRadiusMm die (combat, crushed), those out to launchRadiusMm are launched away from it (launches.json siege-stone); engines and animals stand. hitNear, hitFar and damage are unused by stones. The stone is gone after landing (rolling stones wait for M6).
